title: Panic journal hook doubles backtrace symbolization and ignores RUST_BACKTRACE=0
outcome: Panic journal hook doubles backtrace symbolization and ignores RUST_BACKTRACE=0
acceptance: The panic journal hook honours a caller's explicit RUST_BACKTRACE=0 and does not symbolize a backtrace a second time when std's default hook already captures one (capture once and reuse, or skip when disabled).
The Windows gate-duration effect of the change is measured and recorded, and the review pair finds no Medium or higher.
